'''J-0S4''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] who sold items made by [[Binary Star Realty]] on [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
J-0S4 first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'', an expansion produced by [[BioWare]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
